bugs.detail: Bot proposed a concrete slot time ('¿Te va bien las 10:00?') before calling check_availability in that turn; the preceding update_booking result explicitly flagged next_step='pre_book_validation_required' (slot not yet validated). check_availability was only called in the FOLLOWING turn (8). No incorrect booking resulted (the LLM correctly re-validated before book()), but the phrasing risks presenting an unconfirmed time as if it were checked.
